name: Citizenship by Descent (Jus Sanguinis)

qualifying_event.description: A person with at least one Bulgarian-citizen parent is a Bulgarian citizen by origin, automatically and regardless of place of birth (Citizenship Act Article 8). Gender-neutral -- either parent qualifies.
qualifying_event.evidence_hint: Birth certificate; parent's proof of Bulgarian citizenship.

requirements.blocker_text: At least one parent must be a Bulgarian citizen at the time of the child's birth (Article 8). Applies equally regardless of which parent, and regardless of the child's country of birth.

requirement_groups.name: Minor child of a parent who naturalises

requirements.blocker_text: A child under 14 automatically acquires Bulgarian citizenship when a parent naturalises; a child aged 14-18 acquires it only with the child's own consent (Article 17). A child with one Bulgarian parent may also acquire citizenship with parental consent under similar age rules (Article 18).

sources.title: Bulgaria -- Bulgarian Citizenship Act, Article 8 (citizenship by origin, either parent, gender-neutral), Articles 17-18 (minor children's acquisition on a parent's naturalisation or via a Bulgarian parent, with consent rules for ages 14-18)

notes: NEW COUNTRY BUILD (Bulgaria). Straightforward gender-neutral jus sanguinis rule, unlike several countries documented elsewhere in this dataset with historically gender-asymmetric descent rules (e.g. Egypt). dual_citizenship_allowed modeled true: Article 8 descent does not carry the renunciation condition that Article 12 standard naturalisation does (see bg_naturalisation.json's notes) -- citizenship by descent is an original-acquisition category, not naturalisation, so the same restriction does not apply.
